_field_guide._about: Template input for: python3 ai_model_calculator.py --json <this-file>. When --json is used, ONLY the variants below are analyzed (the project's built-in variants are ignored). This '_field_guide' block is ignored by the loader; delete it or keep it as documentation.
_field_guide._accepted_shapes: This file uses the {"variants": [...]} wrapper. The loader also accepts a bare list [ {...} ] or a single variant object {...}.
_field_guide._required_fields: name, layers, d, dense_layers, total_params_B, active_params_B, valid_pp. Missing any of these fails with a clear error.
_field_guide._recommended_for_accuracy: expert_ffn, dense_ffn, q_heads, kv_heads. These drive the auto-computed parameter counts; omitting q_heads/kv_heads falls back to a coarse d^2*2.25 attention estimate.
_field_guide._optional_fields: head_dim (defaults to d // q_heads), num_experts / n_experts (per-variant expert count; otherwise the project-level N_EXPERTS from configuration/project_config.py is used), shared_each (set > 0 to mark a shared-expert MoE).
_field_guide._auto_computed_do_not_provide: attn_per_layer, expert_each, router_each, moe_layer_params, dense_layer_params are calculated automatically from the fields above. shared_each is computed too, but may be provided to signal shared experts.
_field_guide._dense_vs_moe: Dense model: set expert_ffn = 0 and dense_layers = layers, and omit num_experts. MoE model: set expert_ffn > 0, dense_layers = number of non-MoE (dense) layers (0 if all layers are MoE), and set num_experts.
_field_guide._name_note: name is matched case-insensitively by --model. Keep names unique within this file.
_field_guide._valid_pp_note: valid_pp is the list of pipeline-parallel degrees that evenly divide 'layers'.
